task.title: Firm up source-anchoring on the three WATCH-flagged officer findings (ArriveCAN, POEC, Fox)
task.acceptance: Each of the three WATCH findings gains a firm_source_note citing the exact paragraph/page of the primary-source report. Subsequent LIRIL audit re-scores them PASS.
task.context: In the 2026-04-18 LIRIL audit, ArriveCAN ($59.5M), POEC (Federal-Court-contradicts-POEC ruling), and Fox (violation-then-promotion) were flagged WATCH not because of errors but because the model wanted firmer anchoring. Adding a paragraph-level citation each should flip them to PASS.
